name: Multisig Wallet
description_short: Multi-signature treasury and governance for teams.
description_long: Multi-signature wallet platform for teams, DAOs, and organizations to manage treasury funds and participate in Cardano governance collectively. Wallets are created from native scripts with flexible signing thresholds — all signers, any signer, or at least N of M — and support ada and native tokens. Beyond payments, teams can register as a DRep and vote on governance proposals together, delegate to stake pools, and withdraw staking rewards, all through multi-sig approval. Includes CSV import/export for bulk transactions, ADA Handle resolution, Discord notifications for pending signatures, and a REST API with Swagger docs. Runs on mainnet and preprod, open source under Apache-2.0.
